title: LFM2-24B-A2B layer 28, calendar month offset (month successor computation)

evidence.claim: zeroing the part drops the 'month_successor' skill on held-out items more than random same-size parts
evidence.control: mean drop of 5 random same-size parts
evidence.note: ablation screen in the donor; matched control task changed by -0.0577

signature.label: calendar month offset (month successor computation)
signature.weight_rationale: L28 expert 6's router row favours sequence-like tokens (Roman numerals z=+1.86, digits +1.12, months +.52) and avoids units and pronouns. Its w2 has number-word (.17) and ordinal (.15) aligned columns. L28-29 is where late experts first write month-name directions (L28 e55 cos .29, L29 e48 .36). Attribution put it 2nd (.41), and ablation gave month .424 with the number-successor control at -.056.

skill.description: Name the month that comes k months after a given month (calendar month arithmetic). Control: integer successor with the same sentence frame.
skill.name: month_successor

status_reason: ablation evidence in the donor only; not grafted against a random control yet
